CORE.json.public_claim: Supa 1.7 fine-tuned on 384 solver-verified one-step state-transition examples, no rehearsal. Acquires a capability both frozen cores lack: 234/384 on SELECT-VIEWS-001 against Supa's 14/384, all three families clearing their published shortcut floors. Arithmetic 69/150 permissive and 62/150 strict against Supa's 47 and 41. Long context 162/256 against Supa's 161, paired p=1. Regressions: 8 of 47 source arithmetic answers lost, literal UNKNOWN 13 to 10. One training draw. Not release qualified.

application_base.note: Exact dense Supa 1.7. Supa-A1.1 is a different gated source and was not used.

training.rehearsal_note: Deliberately none. The matched treatment arm added 648 rehearsal rows at double the token budget and lost 27 long-context rows (paired p = 2.53e-05); replay was measured as harmful on this battery, not beneficial.
training.instrument_exclusions: Excludes all 768 scored parents: the historical 384-row transition probe and the new SELECT-VIEWS-001 selection bank. Parent disjointness rechecked by the controller before the worker loaded a model.

acquisition.baseline_note: Both frozen cores score BELOW the strongest answer-agnostic shortcut floor on all three families; Supa's prerequisite_plan and register_machine rates are 0.0000.
acquisition.bank_interchange_warning: SELECT-VIEWS-001 and the historical 384-row probe are DIFFERENT instruments. Supa scores 14 on both coincidentally. Do not rank this core against D1/M4 by subtracting the two banks' headline numbers.

arithmetic_panel.reading: The gain survives strict scoring, so it is not a formatting artifact. But 69 is NOT 47 preserved plus 22 new: it is 39 preserved, 8 lost, 30 newly gained. The legacy per-class monitor fails under both policies.

long_context.reading: The first arm in this programme whose long context is not below the untrained source. Nonsignificance is NOT equivalence and NOT proof of no forgetting: 11 source-correct rows were still lost.

abstention.reading: Abstention regresses. Titan's count is genuinely literal: the strict and legacy substring counters agree at 10, and there are no false abstentions on answerable rows.

gate_v2.caveat: A weaker conjunction than the legacy monitor. It has no long-context term and no abstention term.

AMENDMENT_001.json.subject: The long-context result is substantially a BF16 quantization artifact

what_was_found.summary: This core's stored BF16 weights score 162/256 on long context and 10/64 literal UNKNOWN. The SAME training checkpoint materialized in FP32 without the BF16 export rounding scores 157/256 and 9/64. Acquisition is unchanged within noise: 235 vs 234 on SELECT-VIEWS-001.
what_was_found.matched_conditions: identical implementation digest a329eb7bb0, transformers 4.51.3, max_context 4096, TF32 off, 0 rows skipped

mechanism.explanation: Rounding a 0.056%-relative update to BF16 shrinks it toward the source, so the export behaves like reducing the interpolation coefficient alpha. This core's long context (162) sits with the FP32 interpolants (163-164 at alpha 0.25-0.75), not with its own full-precision parent (157).

what_this_changes.retracted: nothing. The recorded numbers are measurements of the bytes in this directory, which are the bytes that were published.
what_this_changes.corrected_interpretation: CORE.json and README.md present long context 162/256 vs Supa's 161 (paired p=1) as the first arm not to lose long context. That measurement stands, but it should NOT be read as evidence that the training recipe preserves long context. The recipe's full-precision output does not. The preservation is substantially attributable to the lossy BF16 export.
what_this_changes.still_true: This core acquires a capability both frozen cores lack, with all three families clearing their published floors, and it does so without a measured long-context loss as stored.

superseding_candidate.note: INT-001's alpha=0.50 FP32 interpolant beats this core on every preservation endpoint simultaneously: retained 42 vs 39 of 47, long context 164 vs 162, literal UNKNOWN 12 vs 10, at the cost of 15 acquisition points (219 vs 234). It was selected on SELECT-VIEWS-001 and the arithmetic/retention panel only; long context and abstention were report-only and were not used to choose it.
superseding_candidate.reason_not_promoted: INT-001 registered that no arm is promoted on that screen. One seed, and the gate disagreement is unresolved.

CORE.json.public_claim: Supa 1.7 plus the largest 25% by magnitude of the RRP-015 control's update, per tensor, in FP32. Selected by the rule registered in SPARSE001_PREREG.md before any arm was built. Acquires 232/384 on SELECT-VIEWS-001 against Supa's 14/384 with all three families clearing their published floors, arithmetic 72/150 permissive and 63/150 strict against Supa's 47 and 41, 41 of 47 source answers retained, long context 164/256 against Supa's 161, literal UNKNOWN 12/64 against 13. One training draw. Not release qualified.

update_source.note: No new training. This core reuses RRP-015's update; only the update's support is changed.

construction.formula: theta_supa + M_k (x) delta, where delta = theta_ctrl_fp32 - theta_supa over the 220 trained tensors
construction.mask: per-tensor top-k by |delta|, ties broken by ascending flat index via a stable descending argsort
construction.reproducible_from: source 962abc5b... + trained tensors 07156fb5... at k=0.25 via evidence/build_sparse.py
construction.reproducibility_verified: two independent builds produced byte-identical output (a28629c9...)

storage_format_deviation.family_convention: every other core in this vault stores BF16
storage_format_deviation.why: This core's identity IS a magnitude-selected subset of a 0.056%-relative update. Measured: storing it BF16 would round 28.49% of the kept delta elements to ZERO and distort the retained delta norm to 1.0347 by quantization noise. The measured scores below belong to the FP32 bytes and would not transfer to a BF16 copy.
storage_format_deviation.config_torch_dtype: float32, deliberately set so that loading with torch_dtype='auto' cannot silently cast this core to BF16 and discard its update. This is the one sidecar that differs from Supa 1.7.0-devfreeze.
storage_format_deviation.evidence_copy_note: The SPARSE-001 arm directory keeps Supa's byte-identical config.json because the retention probe's hf_checkpoint.verify_hf_candidate requires all six sidecars to match the source. That arm and this core differ only in that file.
storage_format_deviation.size_note: 2x the BF16 cores, an accepted cost of the format

measured.measured_twice: Yes. A first pass with a non-deterministic tie-break and a deterministic re-measurement agreed on EVERY endpoint, so the mask's tie-breaking degrees of freedom have zero measured effect. See SPARSE001_PREREG.md Erratum 1.

AMENDMENT_001.json.subject: REP-001 replicates this core's basis in DIRECTION across three independent draws, but not in MAGNITUDE
AMENDMENT_001.json.why_this_was_registered_in_advance: REP001_PREREG.md prediction 5 committed to recording the outcome in THIS file, whichever way it fell, precisely so a favourable result could not be reported only in its own results document while an unfavourable one was buried.

what_was_tested.design: Two genuinely new training draws (selection seeds 23 and 29) of the identical RRP-015 control recipe, trained from exact Supa, plus the seed-17 anchor. For each draw, BOTH the full FP32 update and its k=0.25 magnitude-pruned variant were measured, so every comparison is paired within draw and only the mask differs.
what_was_tested.draw_independence: 384 distinct parents per draw; pairwise parent overlap 35, 35 and 41 of 384, consistent with independent sampling.

result_direction_replicates.prediction: retained >= its own control AND long context >= its own control, in 2 of 2 new draws
result_direction_replicates.outcome: HELD, 2 of 2 new draws, and 3 of 3 including the anchor
result_direction_replicates.reading: Pruning never made either preservation endpoint worse in any draw.

result_magnitude_does_not_replicate.consequence: This core's own headline gain of +2 over its BF16 sibling, and +7 over its FP32 control, must NOT be quoted as an expected effect. The defensible statement is 'never worse on either preservation endpoint, sometimes substantially better'.
result_magnitude_does_not_replicate.drafting_weakness_recorded: REP-001's predictions 2-4 were written as >=, so seed 23's exactly-zero long-context delta satisfies them. The letter held where the substance was null. A minimum effect size should have been registered.

the_more_useful_finding.claim: Magnitude pruning behaves as a REPAIR that pays most where the damage is worst, not as a uniform gain.
the_more_useful_finding.evidence: Ordering draws by control damage: control long context 157 / 152 / 144 gives pruning gains of +7 / +0 / +15.
the_more_useful_finding.worst_draw: Seed 29's control is the only arm in this programme with statistically detected long-context damage: 144/256, paired exact McNemar p = 0.0115 against Supa's 161, with abstention collapsed to 4/64. Its k=0.25 variant scores 159/256 at p = 0.8450 and restores abstention to 12/64.
the_more_useful_finding.strict_dominance_in_that_draw: At seed 29 pruning is better on EVERY endpoint: acquisition +2, arithmetic +3, strict +6, retained +4, long context +15, abstention +8. No trade at all.
the_more_useful_finding.why_it_matters: The failure mode pruning protects against - a draw that quietly destroys long context and abstention - is exactly the one the registered gate cannot see.

what_this_means_for_this_core_s_own_numb.acquisition: Trustworthy. Control acquisition across three independent draws spans only 7 of 384 (228-235).
what_this_means_for_this_core_s_own_numb.retention_and_long_context: MUCH weaker than the single-draw record implies. Control long context spans 13 rows across draws (144-157) and strict arithmetic spans 13 (51-64). A single-draw retention figure is close to uninformative.
what_this_means_for_this_core_s_own_numb.explicit_caveat: This core's recorded retained 41/47, long context 164/256 and literal UNKNOWN 12/64 are ONE draw's values. They should be read as one sample from a distribution whose spread is larger than the differences being claimed, not as the core's properties.
what_this_means_for_this_core_s_own_numb.applies_equally_to: Rineya-Titan-Experimental-1.0.0-devfreeze, whose retention figures are also single-draw.

AMENDMENT_001.json.replicates_an_older_finding: RRP-013 concluded 'acquisition never varies; what varies is retention, not learning.' REP-001 reproduces that on the new selection-admissible bank with genuinely independent draws.

unchanged.note: Three draws cannot pin a rate, and every long-context and abstention number remains report-only on a SPENT suite.

why_this_is_not_post_hoc.concern: Promoting the winner of a screen can be a rule fitted to a result. This programme forbids that, and both INT-001 and SPARSE-001 registered that they promote nothing.
why_this_is_not_post_hoc.answer: The decision rule was fixed in SPARSE001_PREREG.md before any arm was built, the k grid was fixed at {0.10, 0.25, 0.50} in the same document, and no threshold was adjusted after results were read. This core is the arm that rule selects.
why_this_is_not_post_hoc.rule_as_registered: Among arms whose acquisition clears all three family floors on SELECT-VIEWS-001 by the published lower-bound rule, prefer the arm maximising references_retained subject to arithmetic_permissive >= 62. Ties broken by higher acquisition.

rule_applied.k_0.10: EXCLUDED - 2/3 floors (ledger_replay exact 95% lower bound short of 0.2344)

why_this_is_not_post_hoc.what_did_not_select_it: Long context and literal abstention. Both live on a bank barred TRAIN/SELECTION/CONFIRMATION with reason SPENT, were registered report-only, and were not consulted in the choice. Its 164/256 is therefore reported, not claimed, and selecting on it would have been the post-hoc gate that bar exists to prevent.
why_this_is_not_post_hoc.cross_screen_caution: INT-001's alpha=0.50 arm retains 42, one more than this core. Choosing across two separately registered screens was NOT pre-registered as a selection procedure. This core is promoted as SPARSE-001's registered winner, not as the winner of a post-hoc merge of both screens. The alpha=0.50 arm is recorded and reproducible (ced9d0a8...) should that comparison ever be registered properly.

S4 was added after Stability had been inspected for S1; its threshold used Showcase only.
The 125/192 gain over the 121/192 no-bias control has exact McNemar p=0.2188.
The threshold is calibrated to this model, adapter scale, prompt, and class mix.
Serving stacks that reject remote code need an equivalent logits processor.

qualification_gaps: CRS exact loader/current source/runtime validation not performed
CRS numerical reference and token-by-token/bulk agreement not passed
CRS maximum input/output and sustained resource envelope not measured
No new acquisition, retention, calibration, transfer or serving evidence
Custom abstention code and bias are part of serving identity; dense Qwen class alone changes system

candidates.name: Rineya-Supa-A1.1-1.1.0-devfreeze

supersedes.reason: Identical recipe stored in float16 instead of bfloat16. FP16 keeps 97.8% of the merged LoRA delta against BF16's 82.8% at the same file size, scores 45/64 Showcase against A1's 43, matches 125/192 Stability, and reproduces the offline gate on 256/256 rows where A1 disagreed on 5.

CORE.json.public_claim: Single-pass Supa A-series core, float16 store: 45/64 Showcase (tuning-split checkpoint evaluation), 125/192 previously inspected Stability, 170/256 combined. Abstention is a constant logit offset, not a weight. Requires greedy decoding, float16 load, and trust_remote_code=True. No statistical significance is claimed. Sealed TEST does not exist and has not been run.

abstention.not_stored_in_weights: Qwen3's lm_head is nn.Linear(bias=False) with tied embeddings and no config flag for a head bias, so no checkpoint of this architecture can hold the constant. It is applied in forward, which is why this core needs trust_remote_code=True.
abstention.selection_status: POST-HOC gate, threshold selected on Showcase only; carried over unchanged from Supa-A1
abstention.loader_requirement: trust_remote_code=True. Without it the directory loads as plain Qwen3ForCausalLM with no gate and NO WARNING (121/192 instead of 125/192). Assert type(model).__name__ == 'Qwen3AbstainForCausalLM'.

statistical_position.summary: The abstention gate is worth a stable +4 (S4 form) to +7 (S1 form) on Stability across every numerical realisation tested. No configuration in this family is statistically distinguishable from any other, and the earlier S1 headline of 130/192 at p=0.0490 held only on the BF16 base+adapter arithmetic path.
statistical_position.power: At the observed effect the study has power 0.31 at n=192. Roughly 576 rows would be needed for 80% power.
statistical_position.effect_ci: S1 gate delta +7 rows, 95% paired-pack bootstrap CI [-1, +15]

caveats: No sealed TEST split exists for this suite; the corpus is 64 + 192 rows.
Stability192 has been read many times and is no longer a clean split.
The threshold is calibrated to this model only; on Rineya-Baya-1.7.0 the same gate lowers Showcase from 40 to 35.
Loading without trust_remote_code=True silently disables the gate.
Load in float16; a bfloat16 load re-rounds the weights and discards the precision this core exists to preserve.
